memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest truly is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.” ( Matthew 9:37–38)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Jesus never said the fields were empty; He said the reapers were few. The problem is not the harvest, it is the lack of burdened hearts. A true reaper enters the field with compassion, prayer, and obedience.
He cuts carefully, knowing that every soul belongs to God. The reaper does not seek fame, he seeks souls. But the creeper lurks near the field. He stays close to ministry, yet never enters the harvest.
He talks much about ministry, but carries no burden for souls.

Today the Lord asks only one question:
Are you one who wins souls and reaps ,or one who merely circles the field doing nothing?. The sickle is already prepared in God’s hand. What He is still searching for are holy hands willing to hold it.
A life without soul-burden is like clouds without water. They promise rain but give none; they produce no fruit.

Satan has strategically deployed his workers.
They sow tares of false doctrine, worldly desires, and seeds of pride, destroying the harvest. They want to reap without sowing. Through their schemes, great damage is done. Their deepest desire is not God’s glory, but their own name to be exalted.
In such days, we must be extremely watchful,
to guard ourselves and God’s harvest. The Lord of the harvest is still searching for faithful laborers.
Are we ready?

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God is not looking for famous men, but for men with fire in their hearts.”  Leonard Ravenhill

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, do not allow us to remain near the harvest yet far from Your heart. Father, place the sickle in our hands and the burden of prayer in our hearts.
Grant that we may reap with tears and return with rejoicing. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: God does not honor those who only walk around the field,  He blesses the reapers and crowns them with the crown of victory.

recommended_book.title: Why Revival Tarries

recommended_book.quote: “In the church there are many planners, but few who travail.” “It is in the secret place of prayer that prayer warriors, true reapers are formed.”-   Leonard Ravenhill
